ViewerInfoQuery:
query ViewerInfoQuery {
  viewer {
    __typename
    id
    uid
    autoGeneratedHandle
    ...ViewerStateFragment
    ...BioFragment
    ...HandleFragment
    hasCompletedMultiplayerNux
    promptBotImageDomainAllowlist: promptBotImageDomainWhitelist
    poeUser {
      __typename
      id
      isPoeOnlyUser
      ...UserSnippetFragment
    }
    isEligibleForSubscriptions
    appRatingPromptInfo {
      __typename
      prePromptInfo {
        __typename
        state
        totalImpressions
        lastImpressionTime
      }
      systemPromptInfo {
        __typename
        lastImpressionTime
      }
    }
    shouldSeeResponseSpeedUpsell
    primaryEmail
    numInviteCreationsRemaining
  }
}
fragment ViewerStateFragment on Viewer {
  id
  __typename
  iosMinSupportedVersion: integerGate(gateName: "poe_ios_min_supported_version")
  iosMinEncouragedVersion: integerGate(gateName: "poe_ios_min_encouraged_version")
  advancedImpressionsMinBuildNumber: integerGate(
    gateName: "poe_ios_advanced_impressions_min_build_number"
  )
  removeInviteLimit: booleanGate(gateName: "poe_remove_invite_limit")
  shouldForceSubscriptions: booleanGate(gateName: "poe_force_subscription_state")
  userPrivacyConfidenceBuildNumber: integerGate(
    gateName: "poe_ios_user_privacy_confidence_min_build_number"
  )
  inAppPurchasesIneligibleRegions
  subscriptionMessageLimitExplanationText
  numberofBotsPerCategoryInHomepageCarousel: integerGate(
    gateName: "poe_ios_minimal_number_of_bots_per_category_in_category_carousel"
  )
  numberofCategoriesInHomepageCarousel: integerGate(
    gateName: "poe_ios_number_of_category_carousels_on_home_page"
  )
  useBotImageMetadataMinBuildNumber: integerGate(
    gateName: "poe_bot_metadata_ios_min_build_number"
  )
  useQuickLookForImageMinBuildNumber: integerGate(
    gateName: "poe_use_quicklook_for_images_ios_min_version"
  )
  allowResendForImageBotsMinBuildNumber: integerGate(
    gateName: "poe_resend_button_ios_min_build_number"
  )
  allowMessageRetryMinBuildNumber: integerGate(
    gateName: "poe_retry_button_min_build_number_ios"
  )
  sidebarDesignUpdateMinBuildNumber: integerGate(
    gateName: "poe_ios_sidebar_design_update_min_build_number"
  )
  subscriptionOnboardingFlowVariant
  availableBotsConnection(first: 3) {
    __typename
    edges {
      __typename
      node {
        __typename
        id
        ...BotPreviewFragment
      }
    }
    pageInfo {
      __typename
      hasNextPage
    }
  }
  defaultBot {
    __typename
    id
    botId
  }
  advertisedSubscriptionBots {
    __typename
    id
    botId
  }
  subscription {
    __typename
    id
    isActive
    expiresTime
    purchaseType
    isComplimentary
  }
}
fragment BotPreviewFragment on Bot {
  id
  __typename
  isSystemBot
  botId
  deletionState
  model
  nickname
  displayName
  description
  isPrivateBot
  minBuildNumberIos
  shouldHide
  botImageInfo {
    __typename
    ...BotImageInfoFragment
  }
  translatedBotTags
  monthlyActiveUsers
  messageTimeoutSecs
  isApiBot
  limitedAccessType
  baseModelDisplayName
  viewerIsFollower
  providerName
  messageUsageLimit {
    __typename
    id
    ...MessageUsageLimitFragment
  }
  introduction
  viewerIsCreator
  canUserAccessBot
  supportsFileUpload
}
fragment BotImageInfoFragment on BotImageInfo {
  __typename
  localAssetName
  remoteAssetURL: remoteAssetUrl
  assetTypeToUse
}
fragment MessageUsageLimitFragment on MessageLimit {
  id
  __typename
  canSendMessage
  dailyMessageSent
  freeLimit
  freeLimitBalance
  freeLimitResetTime
  totalBalance
  balanceTooltipText
  shouldShowLimitInfoBanner
}
fragment BioFragment on Viewer {
  __typename
  id
  poeUser {
    __typename
    id
    uid
    bio
  }
}
fragment HandleFragment on Viewer {
  __typename
  id
  poeUser {
    __typename
    id
    uid
    handle
  }
}
fragment UserSnippetFragment on PoeUser {
  __typename
  id
  uid
  bio
  handle
  fullName
  viewerIsFollowedBy
  viewerIsFollowing
  isFollowable
  profilePhotoURLTiny: profilePhotoUrl(size: tiny)
  profilePhotoURLSmall: profilePhotoUrl(size: small)
  profilePhotoURLMedium: profilePhotoUrl(size: medium)
  profilePhotoURLLarge: profilePhotoUrl(size: large)
  creationTime
}
